svg.text: Executed archival audit: fixed 420-case results
Coverage and dispositions
420 / 420 source identities in exact order; 60 targets, 7 cases each, selected by p=739 from a
180-record archive. Recomputed: 218 collector-ineligible; 202 eligible = 174 first occurrences + 28
redundant duplicates; 0 informative candidates. Native exit0. No missing, failed or post-terminal
disposition.
The preserved pattern
All 28 duplicates are case6 versus case3 within the same target: designed -(G+Q) versus G+Q. Their
canonically signed coefficient difference is (0,0). Across all60 targets the original case6 labels
and divisors negate case3. Graph forwarding:174 edges,28 suppressions,0 cycles,0 terminal answers.
These are coordinate-validation fixtures, not sampled collector paths.
Setup accounting: aggregate each target once
All60 ledger entries agree across their seven row copies.
Setup checks:3904 Jacobian operations;438198 M;8436 S;14252 I;760038 field additions.
Constructor:2640 Jacobian operations;299213 M;5631 S;9823 I;519770 field additions.
Reference, eligibility, adapter and graph phases remain separate; scalar and field counters are not
conflated.
Independent review and exclusions
Reviewer independently recomputed coverage, split-root eligibility, signed normalization, duplicate
classifications and the once-per-target ledger. Frozen source/control hashes matched. No native
rerun: admission permitted one attempt. Native label checks verify D=aG+bQ and Q=kG against public
known answers; controls include deliberately planted informative labels.
Hashing, comparisons, memory, primality arithmetic, dense reference arithmetic, internal expansion
and complete runtime work are not fully priced. No comparative clock, natural-yield estimate, cost
ratio or ranking is reported.
Scope retained
The original four-lead and five-followup criteria remain unchanged, including the full1,260-target
requirement and separate18-slot upper gate. This snapshot adds component evidence and an archival
correctness audit; previous aggregate snapshots are preserved. index.json binds exact producer and
independent-review paths and hashes.
